notes: The independent second reading found seven local graphic refinements. No live word, symbol, index, prime, numeral, sign, deletion reading or punctuation in the consolidated prose/formulas is changed.

The two top R3 endpoint labels remain identically primed as written; the lower Q1 exponent remains omega-squared, and the upper-left R2 endpoint retains its separate tilde. These readings were checked against the actual labels, not imposed by symmetry.

The crossed/looped residue beside Q3 is physically distinct from the dark cross. Its function and chronology are not assigned. The small-circle pen break and the lower R2 rim interruption likewise carry no added topological assertion.

The R2 short mark is rendered as an interrupted dark shaft, a pale connection and a separate dark tapered patch. A standard arrowhead would add geometry not securely present. The separate left-facing head on the long front upper rim is identifiable.

The seven pre-existing local doubts remain necessary: the two Q3 overworked marks, the low cancelled suffixes after the lower R1 and R2 labels, the pq-versus-P_i prose opening, the cancelled prose superscript and the first formula cancelled superscript. Reused crops did not resolve these by ink.

The formula with R_{omega^4 i} is retained literally. The visible angular 4 is not changed to a mathematically expected 2. The twelve-value claim and that second formula are not newly proved or refuted in this audit.

For H, only supplied local statements were compared. Its generic drawing prose does not specify the seven newly refined stroke/terminal details; differences in unavailable underlying H drawings are not asserted.
The isolated blot below/right of the large upper drawing and small detached background specks have no label/path role; they remain excluded as incidental marks.
Main independently reviewed both new crops and the two reused R1/R2 crops for all seven candidates and approved the literal geometric readings before this return.
